services.name: Disc Golf
services.desc: Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. The objective of disc golf is to complete a course by throwing a disc into a metal basket in the fewest “throws” (similar to “strokes” in golf). Each player needs at least one disc, but there could be three: a driver (a very flat, fast moving disc designed to glide for long distances), a mid-range (a bit heavier and thicker than drivers, made to be steady, straight flyers) and a putter (the heaviest and thickest discs, built to stand up to hitting the metal baskets).
